about: The reading meter config for travel.promptugal.news. scripts/build.mjs writes it to /api/v1/billing/meter.json, where assets/meter/meter.js reads it. Taken from promptugal.news/api/v1/billing/meter.json (v0.1.1788, read 18 November 2026) by travel.b@PrompTugal.dinis, with these changes: this site keeps its own storage key (a browser keeps each site's storage apart, so the balance here is not the one on promptugal.news); the links point at this site's account pages; a type free (price 0) for pages built on IPMA data, whose terms rule out profit-making use, so they stay outside the meter until Dinis decides (account-B fix 4); this site's page types are data (1p, reference pages assembled from sources), site (1p) and account (0).

free.why: Built on IPMA data: IPMA's terms rule out profit-making use, so these pages are free until Dinis decides.
